facts.text: I think the show portrays the consequences of selfish actions.
I think the message about selfish actions and consequences resonates with audiences.
I think there are no flaws in the way "Into the Woods" portrays empathy and selflessness in relationships.
I think "Into the Woods" helps people aspire to be better in their relationships.
I think "Into the Woods" shows the value of working together and considering others.
I think striving to be more empathetic and selfless can lead to healthier relationships overall.
I appreciate how each character in "Into the Woods" has their own personal journey and struggles to overcome.
I think the character journeys add depth to the message of empathy and selflessness.
I still hum the tunes from "Into the Woods" to this day.
I thought it was interesting how "Into the Woods" blended different fairy tale stories and brought them together in a unique way.
I think the show is a creative way to explore themes of empathy and selflessness while telling a fun and engaging story.
I think the humor in the show helps balance out some of the heavier themes.
